description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on the MATH-500 test, categorized into five bins. The horizontal axis represents the Pass@1 accuracy bins, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of occurrences, ranging from 0.0% to 0.8%. The chart features five bars, each corresponding to a bin of Pass@1 accuracy. The first bar represents the 0.0-0.2 bin with an approximate value of 11.2%, the second and third bars, both representing the 0.2-0.4 and 0.4-0.6 bins, have an approximate value of 3.4% each, and the fourth bar, representing the 0.6-0.8 bin, has an approximate value of 5.8%. The tallest bar corresponds to the 0.8-1.0 bin, with a value of 76.2%, and a mean value of 0.82 is indicated by a dashed line. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
